'''Fali''' is an unclassified [[Benue-Congo language]] of [[Nigeria]], spoken in the town of Baissa in [[Taraba State]].  The language is unwritten, and there are few to no speakers remaining.

==Genetic affiliation==
Baissa Fali belongs to the [[Benue–Congo languages|Benue–Congo]] sub-family of the [[Niger–Congo languages]]. Its position within this family remains a matter of discussion.<ref>Williamson, Kay (1989) 'Benue–Congo Overview', pp. 248–274 in Bendor-Samuel, John & Rhonda L. Hartell (eds.) The Niger–Congo Languages – A classification and description of Africa's largest language family. Lanham, Maryland: University Press of America.</ref>
